## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link related issues when relevant.

## Validation

List the checks run and their results. Include browser/audio/device evidence when
the change affects those behaviors, and state what remains unverified.

## Public contracts

Describe affected exports, types, dependencies, documentation, and asset licenses.

## Sign-off

- [ ] Every commit carries a `Signed-off-by` trailer (`git commit -s`) under the
      [Developer Certificate of Origin](../DCO).
